title: Nền vườn theo mẫu khuông (9 mẫu), sửa từ bg_garden
decisions: Decision 056 (owner, 2026-11-09): instead of pasting decoration sprites over the scene, each plot skin gets its OWN backdrop (the existing bg_garden re-lit and re-coloured to the skin's mood), and the rank adds light, petals and fireflies by code on top. One sheet per skin, one cell, fit backdrop, same pixel size as the source. Cells are named bg_garden_<skin>; the game uses them for the tier / zone wearing that skin (SKIN_BACKDROP_READY in src/core/config/plotSkins.ts lists the ones delivered).

sheets.name: B1
sheets.title: Nền verdant
sheets.prompt: Edit this a farm garden game background picture into a lush green forest-glade mood: fresh spring greens, dappled sunlight, tiny ferns and clover on the grass, a soft green-gold sky. Keep the EXACT same image size, framing, composition, camera, island shapes, the cream field in the middle, every object position, art style and level of detail. Only change the colour grading, the light, the sky and the mood, plus a few small thematic touches (flowers, plants, glow) that stay on the existing shapes. Do NOT add any text, UI, characters or new large objects. Nothing may overlap the central field where game plots will be drawn. Original design, no resemblance to any other game, film or brand.

cells.desc: a farm garden game background picture in a lush green forest-glade mood
